title: Build realtime waveform and meter bridge
description:
Create the WaveformBridge C++ class and WaveformView QML component that render live waveform and level-meter data from bounded audio snapshots without touching PipeWire realtime buffers directly.

Before editing, inspect:
- src/audio/CaptureMetrics.hpp for the CaptureMetricsSnapshot struct (peak, RMS, framesCaptured, overflowCount) that the bridge will read from.
- src/audio/AudioRingBuffer.hpp for the bounded ring buffer API; the bridge must never hold a reference into the realtime buffer — pass bounded snapshots only.
- Any existing QQuickPaintedItem or QQuickItem subclasses in src/ui/ for rendering conventions.
- qml/components/ for shared style tokens and sizing.

Do not infer APIs, schemas, behavior, or file contents; inspect the referenced files first.

Implementation:
- src/ui/WaveformBridge.hpp / .cpp: A QObject (or QQuickItem subclass) that receives bounded audio snapshots via a queued signal/slot connection. Expose Q_PROPERTYs for per-channel peak and RMS levels, and a method or property that provides the current waveform sample buffer to QML. Never hold a reference into the realtime ring buffer; copy or consume bounded snapshots only. Provide a configurable snapshot window size.
- qml/components/WaveformView.qml: Renders the waveform using Canvas, Shape, or a suitable QtQuick element. Displays a level meter bar alongside the waveform. Updates at a UI-friendly rate (target 30–60 fps refresh, not audio-rate). Must remain responsive during capture.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Snapshot handoff: Before editing, inspect src/audio/CaptureSession.hpp for the bounded CaptureVisualizationSnapshot value-copy reader established in Phase C; it is the waveform sample source. CaptureMetricsSnapshot supplies only peak/RMS/integrity metrics, not waveform samples. Implement a queued GUI-thread slot that accepts bounded value copies supplied by f.3 from CaptureSession. WaveformBridge must not include, read, drain, or retain references into AudioRingBuffer.
acceptance_criteria: src/ui/WaveformBridge.hpp and src/ui/WaveformBridge.cpp exist and define a QObject or QQuickItem subclass with Q_PROPERTYs for peak and RMS levels
WaveformBridge accepts audio snapshots via a slot and does not include PipeWire headers or reference pw_stream or pw_core directly
qml/components/WaveformView.qml exists and renders waveform and level meter visuals
WaveformBridge does not perform file I/O, compression, or blocking synchronization
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
WaveformBridge waveform samples enter only through its queued bounded-snapshot slot; CaptureMetricsSnapshot is used only for metrics and AudioRingBuffer is neither included nor accessed
forbidden_changes: modify any file under src/pipewire/ or src/engine/
hold references into realtime ring buffers
perform file I/O or compression in the bridge class

allowed: choose between QQuickPaintedItem and QObject with Canvas-based QML rendering
choose snapshot buffer representation (QVector<float>, QByteArray, etc.)
add local helper for dB conversion
forbidden: introduce a custom rendering framework or OpenGL backend
add direct PipeWire or audio-engine dependencies to UI layer

verification_commands.name: waveform_bridge_cpp_syntax
command: c++ -std=c++20 -fsyntax-only $(pkg-config --cflags Qt6Core Qt6Qml Qt6Quick) -I src src/ui/WaveformBridge.cpp
